description: This file defines various data schemas for request and response models used across multiple API endpoints. It uses pydantic's BaseModel for data validation and serialization, covering authentication, chat, feedback, guidance, and document processing functionalities.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Schema for login request containing username and password.

classes.name: LoginResponse
classes.description: Schema for login response containing a JWT token.

classes.name: ChatRequest
classes.description: Schema for chat input message and language.

classes.name: ChatResponse
classes.description: Schema for chat response message and language.

classes.name: FeedbackRequest
classes.description: Schema for user feedback submission, including optional rating.

classes.name: FeedbackResponse
classes.description: Schema indicating submission status of feedback.

classes.name: GuidanceRequest
classes.description: Schema for guidance queries including user ID and preferred language.

classes.name: GuidanceResponse
classes.description: Schema for guidance response with generated reply and language.

classes.name: DocumentProcessingResponse
classes.description: Schema representing structured data extracted from documents.

classes.name: DocumentUploadResponse
classes.description: Schema representing data extracted from uploaded documents, meant for frontend integration.
